name: http-mdk-launch
description: Authenticated HTTP launcher for one MDK 0.6 site on Railway

scripts.build:docs: mkdir -p dist/docs && redocly build-docs openapi/launch.openapi.yaml -o dist/docs/index.html --theme.openapi.schemaDefinitionsTagName=Schemas --theme.openapi.theme.colors.primary.main='#f7931a' && cp openapi/launch.openapi.yaml dist/docs/openapi.yaml
